Key evidence recovered:

- 2B: The Egyptian Presidency records Sisi–Biden agreement on sustained Rafah aid coordination on 19 October 2023, while OCHA records 100 trucks entering from Egypt on 10 December—well below the prewar average. Attribution is direct for coordination but not sole control of throughput. [Presidency record](https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news19101923/), [OCHA Flash Update 65](https://www.ochaopt.org/content/hostilities-gaza-strip-and-israel-flash-update-65).

- 3B: OHCHR records at least 88 October arrests, 67 pretrial detentions, six alleged enforced disappearances, and poor detention conditions. Amnesty independently documents arbitrary arrests and disappearances during Palestine-solidarity protests. [OHCHR communication](https://spcommreports.ohchr.org/TmSearch/SummaryPrint?id=30539), [Amnesty report](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2023/11/egypt-authorities-step-up-repression-ahead-of-presidential-elections/). The government’s announcement of 31 planned releases is retained as mitigating context.

- 4B: HRW supplies a precise 25 September election decree, 217 notary offices, endorsement obstacles, security harassment, and 73–127 detained Tantawy supporters. The official NEA result page records 66.8% turnout and Sisi’s 39,702,451 votes. [HRW election investigation](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/12/18/egypt-violations-repression-upstage-presidential-vote), [NEA result page](https://www.elections.eg/2023-09-19-22-59-19/pres-2024-mob/pres-2024-result-mob).

- 5B: CBE reported 38.1% annual core inflation in October and held rates at 19.25%, 20.25%, and 19.75% in September. IMF documentation identifies the authorities’ promised flexible-exchange-rate, state-ownership, and social-spending reforms. [CBE October release](https://www.cbe.org.eg/en/news-publications/news/2023/11/12/12/40/cpi-press-release-october-2023), [CBE September MPC release](https://www.cbe.org.eg/en/news-publications/news/2023/09/21/16/02/mpc-press-release-21-september-2023), [IMF program statement](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2023/01/10/tr011023-transcript-of-egypt-press-briefing).

- 6B: World Bank reports that Takaful and Karama reached 4.67 million households—about 17 million people—by December 2023; 51% met health conditionality, 63% met education attendance conditionality, and all beneficiaries were paid electronically. Egypt’s Health Care Authority separately reports 4.3 million unified medical files and 127 accredited facilities. [World Bank results report](https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs), [EHA implementation summary](https://eha.gov.eg/ar/news/2july2023/).

- 7B: Sisi’s Decree 361/2023 renewed Amr Adel as acting chair of the Administrative Control Authority from 30 August for one year. This is direct evidence of institutional control, not proof of personal corruption. The ACA’s 2023–2030 anti-corruption strategy is retained as official program/context evidence only. [SIS decree report](https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-sisi-renews-appointment-of-amr-adel-as-aca-acting-head/), [ACA strategy page](https://aca.gov.eg/Malafat/4/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%85%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%AF-2023---2030.aspx).

- 8B: The World Bank cash-transfer record provides concrete positive delivery evidence. OECD reports that the New Administrative Capital government district began functioning in mid-2023, under presidential authority, with an interministerial coordination structure; it also notes that ACUD financial statements and project liabilities were not publicly available. [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs), [OECD Economic Survey, pp. 57–58](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2024/02/oecd-economic-surveys-egypt-2024_ad9fc8a4/af900de2-en.pdf).

No score was assigned. Remaining gaps are chiefly direct Egyptian military records on external conduct, independently audited 2023 program outcomes, nationwide health/education measures, and evidence of personal enrichment or personal correction by Sisi.
